=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:test_config_contract (and scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh default `config=` line) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR does not add .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json, but both test_config_contract and the script's default config path (`config="${CHATGPT_POOL_CONFIG:-${script_dir}/../.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json}"`) depend on it.
  WHY: CI `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` already fails with `FAILED tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py::test_config_contract - FileNotFoundError: ... .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (1 failed, 49 passed), and with the default config_path the action always ends `available=false reason=config_missing`. The source severity was BLOCKER.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:838-842, 919-920 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In createChatgptStore → refresh(), `if (response.status === 401 || (response.status === 400 && fields.error === "invalid_grant"))` sets the permanent `refresh_rejected` latch on any 401, even though a 401 means invalid_client (a misconfigured CHATGPT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID or CHATGPT_REFRESH_URL) under RFC 6749 §5.2.
  WHY: After a client misconfiguration, a still-valid refresh token stays latched and every grant returns `credential_refresh_rejected`; fixing the var does not clear it, and only a new CHATGPT_POOL_SEED does. All reviewers rated this NIT; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:161 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: refresh() puts a permanent latch on a 401 response.
  WHY: Latching on a 401 (invalid_client per RFC 6749 §5.2, often caused by misconfiguration) makes the credential permanently unavailable even when the problem was temporary, and only a manual seed change clears it. The source severity was NIT. This is probably the same root cause as the 838 entry, but the cited line does not overlap, so it is kept separate.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:626-633 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The handleChatgpt non-Refusal catch-all (`deps.log("CHATGPT_POOL broker error reason=internal"); return json(500, { error: "internal" });`) returns HTTP 500, but the issue spec and changelog say broker-side trouble is 503.
  WHY: An unexpected broker exception makes the action report `broker_unavailable_500`, which breaks the documented 503 contract (changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-token.md:6-7, index.ts header lines 47-49). It still fails closed. Reviewers disagreed on whether it matches /v1/pool: sonnet says it mirrors the /v1/pool catch-all at line 674, while minimax says /v1/pool returns 503 `broker_unavailable`. All rated it NIT.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:649 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: handleChatgpt returns 500 on unexpected errors.
  WHY: The spec requires 503 for broker-side trouble, but an unhandled error gives a 500 response, which reports an unavailable service as an internal error. The source severity was NIT. This is probably the same root cause as the 626-633 entry, but the cited line is more than 5 lines away, so it is kept separate.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The file is absent from pr_changed_files.txt, last_commit_stat.txt and the PR diff, and the `.github/ai/` listing on the PR head has no chatgpt_pool.json, the tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:30 `CONFIG = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "ai" / "chatgpt_pool.json"` and test_config_contract (lines 481-491) fail in CI `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` with FileNotFoundError, the scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:37 default config path makes the action end `available=false reason=config_missing` (line 131), changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-token.md line 2 describes the file as present, and the required content is `{"schema_version": 1, "broker_url": "https://claude-pool-broker.shubhodeep.workers.dev/v1/chatgpt", "audience": "coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool", "reviewer_slot_enabled": false}` (audience == `CHATGPT_AUDIENCE` at tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:134, and != claude_engine.json `oidc_audience`)

- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:838 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Any 401 from the token endpoint sets the permanent refresh_rejected latch, but a 401 means invalid_client (wrong CHATGPT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID or token URL) per RFC 6749 §5.2.
  WHY: A still-valid refresh token gets latched and grantOnce returns `credential_refresh_rejected`; only a new CHATGPT_POOL_SEED clears it. Impact is limited to operator misconfiguration after go-live.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:632 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The handleChatgpt catch-all returns HTTP 500 for a non-Refusal exception, but the issue specifies 503 for broker-side trouble.
  WHY: The action reports `broker_unavailable_500` instead of a 503 code. It still fails closed and mirrors the /v1/pool catch-all at line 674.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Add `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (broker URL, audience, etc., per the plan) with `reviewer_slot_enabled: false`. Do not set it to true." (issue #8970 requirement 3)
  Expected change site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file)
  Evidence of absence: The file is missing from pr_changed_files.txt, last_commit_stat.txt and the PR diff, and the .github/ai/ glob returns only claude_engine.json. changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-token.md line 2, the scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh default path and test_config_contract all assume it exists.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1):
  - index.ts line 838: latch only on 400 invalid_grant and update the "a 401" test in tools/claude-pool-broker/test/broker.test.ts.
  - index.ts line 632: return 503 on /v1/chatgpt only.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:handleChatgpt catch block | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A non-Refusal exception returns HTTP 500 `{ error: "internal" }`, while /v1/pool returns 503 `{ error: "broker_unavailable" }` and the spec says broker-side trouble is 503.
  WHY: The script reports `broker_unavailable_500`, which contradicts `changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-token.md:6-7` ("503 on broker-side trouble") and is inconsistent with /v1/pool.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:createChatgptStore -> refresh() `if (response.status === 401 || (response.status === 400 && fields.error === "invalid_grant"))` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A 401 (invalid_client, i.e. a misconfigured CHATGPT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID or CHATGPT_REFRESH_URL) is treated like 400 invalid_grant and latches the refresh token as rejected.
  WHY: After fixing the config, every grant still returns credential_refresh_rejected until the Durable Object is re-seeded. The fix is to latch on 400 invalid_grant only, and the parametrized test `a 401 ... latches the rejection` should expect `credential_refresh_failed`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Add `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (broker URL, audience, etc., per the plan) with `reviewer_slot_enabled: false`. **Do not set it to true**; go-live is a separate human PR." (Issue #8970, Requirements §3)
  Expected change site: `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (new file at the repository root)
  Evidence of absence: The file is absent from `pr_changed_files.txt`, `last_commit_stat.txt` and the PR patch. `tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:30` CONFIG and `test_config_contract` (line 481) fail in CI with FileNotFoundError, and the scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh default gives `available=false reason=config_missing`. `changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-token.md:2` advertises the file. Required keys are exactly `{schema_version, broker_url, audience, reviewer_slot_enabled}`, with audience == `CHATGPT_AUDIENCE` and != claude_engine.json `oidc_audience`.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
